# TossController

> Pick up an element, fling it with momentum — physics-based deceleration, gravity, spin, and optional edge bounce.

## Constructor

```ts
new TossController(host: HTMLElement, options?: TossOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `friction` | `number` | no | Deceleration factor per frame — 0.95 = slows 5% each frame (default 0.95) |
| `bounce` | `boolean` | no | Bounce off viewport edges (default true) |
| `bounceDamping` | `number` | no | Velocity multiplier on bounce (default 0.6) |
| `gravity` | `number` | no | Gravity — px/frame² added to vertical velocity each frame. 0 = no gravity (default 0) |
| `spin` | `boolean` | no | Track angular velocity from pointer movement and spin during momentum (default false) |
| `returnOnEnd` | `boolean` | no | Animate back to origin after momentum ends (default false) |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Disable the controller |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Readonly |
|----------|------|----------|
| `animating` | `boolean` | yes |
| `x` | `number` | yes |
| `y` | `number` | yes |
| `rotation` | `number` | yes |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `native:bounce` | `{ edge, x, y, velocityX, velocityY }` |
| `native:toss` | `{ x, y, velocityX, velocityY, bounces, rotation }` |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `attach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `detach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { TossController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new TossController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
